reviews.review:
TL;DR: It's slow. It's a huge grind. It's annoying and tedious. Satisfying gameplay is gobbled up rapidly. Play a different digging game.


The fun wears off very quickly. It's more of a grind than anything. Max level is reached quickly, you run out of things to buy, and you can only buy things one at a time. Buying multiple cave dynamite is so tedious that it becomes a game of patience. The sheer slog of digging through the dirt only to find everything is a dead end in every direction you look is soul crushing. Even with the drill it's so slow. The automated digging drills are so slow and expensive that they become effectively useless. The inability to stack items in your inventory makes things even more tedious and annoying.
reviews.developer_response:
First of all, thank you for the valuable feedback! We’re doing our best to incorporate the good ideas into future updates.
This current(v1.214) update improves two main things: quick purchases and item organization in the inventory.
From now on, the inventory works with a stacking system, allowing players to carry large quantities of identical items.
Of course, we’ll continue updating the game regularly, but we hope this update already marks a big step toward a better overall experience.
